Active Learning for Feasible Region Discovery

High FEA & Surrogate Modelling openalex Transferable Read now simulation_case
Nicolas Knudde, Ivo Couckuyt, Kohei Shintani, Tom Dhaene 2019-12-01 10.1109/icmla.2019.00106
单位: Department of Information Technology, Ghent University - imec, IDLab, Ghent, Belgium
通讯: Nicolas Knudde @ Department of Information Technology, Ghent University - imec, IDLab, Ghent, Belgium
相关性: 该论文提出的主动学习方法可用于高效发现可行域，直接解决昂贵仿真采样效率问题，且方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的约束处理。
边界: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification (UQ) for surrogate models, nor does it apply to implant/biomechanics design specifically.
动机· 设计过程中可行域未知且约束无解析形式，需高效采样建模。
方法· 提出基于信息论的主动采样策略，仅关注可行性而非回归精度。
结果· 在合成和工程实例中优于现有方法。
验证· 通过两个合成算例和一个工程算例验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· In engineering design, feasible regions are often defined by expensive-to-evaluate constraints with no analytical form, requiring efficient sampling strategies.
Method· An information-theoretic active learning strategy is proposed to model feasible regions using regression models while focusing only on feasibility classification.
Result· The method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on two synthetic examples and one engineering example.
Validation· Validation is performed on two synthetic benchmarks and one engineering case study.
active learning · 主动学习feasible region · 可行域constraint modeling · 约束建模expensive simulations · 昂贵仿真information-theoretic sampling · 信息论采样design space · 设计空间regression model · 回归模型classification accuracy · 分类精度
active learning feasible region constraint modeling expensive simulations information-theoretic sampling

A biomechanical study of the effect of weight loading conditions on the mechanical environment of the hip joint endoprosthesis.

High Hip Implant & Femoral Stem pubmed Direct Read now in_vitro Exp. validation
Ioannis-Ilias K Farmakis, Vassiliki T Potsika, Andreas-Foivos Smyris, Ioannis D Gelalis, Dimitrios I Fotiadis et al. Clinical biomechanics (Bristol, Avon) 2019-12-01 10.1016/j.clinbiomech.2019.10.002
单位: Unit of Medical Technology and Intelligent Information Systems, Dept. of Materials Science and Engineering, University of Ioannina, GR 45110 Ioannina, Greece.
通讯: Dimitrios I Fotiadis @ Unit of Medical Technology and Intelligent Information Systems, Dept. of Materials Science and Engineering, University o
相关性: 直接相关，通过测量不同体重下的Gruen区域微应变量化应力遮挡和假体周围骨折风险。
边界: Does not report micromotion values, does not compare intact vs implanted femur, and uses composite models instead of patient-specific geometry.
动机· 探究不同体重对髋关节假体周围力学环境的影响
方法· 在复合股骨模型上测量单腿站立时Gruen区域的微应变
结果· 微应变随体重增加，大粗隆区域应力遮挡最显著
验证· 通过粘贴应变片的复合股骨体外实验验证
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how varying body weight affects the mechanical environment around a hip implant, particularly regarding stress shielding and fracture risk.
Method· Micro strains were measured at critical Gruen zones on composite femoral models under single-leg stance loads representative of normal-weight and overweight individuals.
Result· Micro strains increased with weight, with the greatest relative increase in Gruen zone 1 (great trochanter), indicating heightened stress shielding, and significant increases in zones 3, 5, and 11 suggesting elevated periprosthetic fracture risk.
Validation· In-vitro experiment using composite femurs with strain gauges, loaded under simulated single-leg stance conditions.

Motivation· To achieve sustained release of BMP-2 from titanium implants for enhanced bone regeneration.
Method· A porous Ti-alloy implant was fabricated via 3D printing, microarc oxidation, and electrochemical co-precipitation of Ca,P with BMP-2.
Result· The MAO-CaP-BMP2 group exhibited sustained BMP-2 release over 35 days and significantly improved osseointegration and bone formation.

Motivation· To investigate the effect of oxygen pickup during selective laser melting on the mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V lattice structures.

Validation· Compression mechanical testing combined with microstructural characterization.

Motivation· To quantify the distribution of proximal tibial sclerotic bone and its effect on prosthesis stability in total knee arthroplasty using finite element analysis.

Motivation· To investigate whether altered proximal femoral morphology in DDH affects cementless stem anteversion and to develop a preoperative CT-based prediction method.
Method· Retrospective analysis of 34 DDH hips with metaphyseal-filling stems; patients were grouped by presence of calcar femorale, and multiple regression was used to predict stem anteversion from anatomical parameters.
Result· In the calcar femorale group, a combination of CF-LFN and FA-CLT showed strong correlation (R=0.870) with postoperative anteversion, with a mean prediction error of 5.9°.

Motivation· To determine whether cup oversizing relative to native femoral head size is a risk factor for postoperative groin pain after total hip arthroplasty.

动机· 提高下肢肌肉骨骼模型预测髋关节接触力的准确性。
方法· 基于解剖数据构建包裹肌肉路径模型，结合步态分析数据进行逆动力学计算。
结果· 新模型预测髋关节接触力的均方根误差比默认模型降低40%。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the accuracy of hip contact force prediction in lower extremity musculoskeletal models by incorporating realistic muscle paths.
Method· A wrapping muscle model was constructed by placing via-point muscles along multiple ellipsoids to reproduce curvilinear muscle paths, and inverse dynamics analysis was performed using motion capture data.
Result· The developed model reduced the root mean square error of hip contact force prediction by 40% compared to the default model (0.208 BW vs 0.359 BW).
Validation· Validation was conducted using walking data from total hip arthroplasty patients and measured hip contact forces from the OrthoLoad database.

动机· 提高零样本学习效率，减少对全部源域数据的依赖。
方法· 使用主动学习选择相关类别，结合耦合语义自编码器联合学习源域和目标域。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve zero-shot learning efficiency by actively selecting relevant source classes instead of using all data passively.
Method· Active learning selects a subset of relevant classes, and coupled semantic autoencoders jointly learn source and target domain parameters.
Result· The hybrid approach achieves up to 16% and 8% improvement over state-of-the-art on AWA2 and CUB datasets in attribute and word embedding spaces respectively.
Validation· Validated on standard zero-shot learning benchmarks AWA2 and CUB-UCSD.

Motivation· To compare the accuracy of six anteversion measurement methods on two types of anteroposterior radiographs for cup component orientation after total hip arthroplasty.

Validation· Accuracy was validated against reference angles using custom models, and intra- and inter-observer reliabilities were assessed.

Motivation· To investigate whether radial head prosthesis design parameters are associated with early failure.
Method· A systematic review of 34 articles, grouping prostheses by material, fixation, modularity, and polarity, with chi-square tests for failure reasons.
Result· Aseptic loosening (30%), elbow stiffness (20%), and pain (17%) are the most common failure modes; press-fit prostheses show higher loosening rates.
Validation· No experimental validation; based on literature review.

边界: No biomechanical modeling, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion analysis, no FEA, and no comparison of intact vs implanted femur.
动机· 评估三维C臂定位下钽棒植入治疗股骨头坏死的临床效果。
方法· 回顾性比较三维C臂与传统C臂定位下钽棒植入的临床指标。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the clinical efficacy of porous tantalum rod implantation with 3D C-arm navigation for early-stage femoral head necrosis.
Method· A retrospective comparative study of 50 patients (58 hips) receiving tantalum rod implantation with either 3D or conventional C-arm guidance.
Result· The 3D C-arm group showed shorter operation time, less blood loss, and more accurate rod placement, but no significant difference in VAS or Harris scores versus the conventional group.
Validation· Clinical validation with 4-year follow-up data including VAS, Harris scores, and survival rate.

边界: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any biomechanical metrics; it is purely clinical microbiology and antibiotic treatment for prosthetic joint infection.
动机· 探讨髋膝关节置换术后假体感染的微生物学及抗生素敏感性
方法· 回顾性分析2010-2015年146例假体感染患者的微生物及药敏数据

验证· 临床回顾性数据分析
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate the microbiology and antibiotic susceptibility patterns of prosthetic joint infections after hip and knee arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective review of 146 patients with prosthetic hip or knee infection from 2010 to 2015, analyzing culture results and antibiotic sensitivity.
Result· Gram-positive bacteria, especially Staphylococcus epidermidis and Staphylococcus aureus, were predominant; empirical antibiotics should cover staphylococci.
Validation· Clinical retrospective data analysis.

方法· 使用生成对抗网络进行半监督学习，结合分类器与生成模型。

Motivation· Limited labeled samples in exo-atmospheric infrared target recognition hinder effective classification of time series.
Method· A semi-supervised learning approach using generative adversarial networks combines a neural network classifier with an adversarial generation model.
Result· Effective classification of infrared grayscale time series is achieved with few labeled samples, outperforming other methods.
Validation· Experimental validation demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

相关性: 该论文研究雷达目标分类，与髋关节植入物和股骨柄的生物力学分析无关。
边界: This paper focuses on radar target classification using micro-Doppler signals, with no mention of hip implants, femoral stems, stress shielding, micromotion, or finite element analysis.
动机· 提高地面监视雷达对移动目标的分类性能
方法· 使用广义线性调频小波变换和旋转不变伪Zernike矩提取特征，k-NN分类

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve classification performance of moving targets in ground surveillance radar systems.
Method· Proposes a general linear chirplet transform combined with rotation-invariant pseudo Zernike moments for feature extraction, followed by k-NN classification.
Result· Achieves 95% classification accuracy at signal-to-noise ratios above 25dB, outperforming existing methods.
Validation· Numerical experiments comparing with state-of-the-art methods on simulated radar data.
